goal: Inspect customer, vendor and item/service template, dropdown, mandatory-field and cancel-boundary behavior read-first before any Master Data write gate.
whyNow: MASTER-DATA-TEMPLATE-ROUTE-DECISION concluded that observed Master Data list surfaces are useful but do not prove template safety or mandatory-field behavior.
businessPurpose: Give the agent better eyes on real Business Central master-data creation routes while preserving the no-write boundary for realistic customer-project setup.
expectedOutput: Read-first result JSON with customer, vendor and item/service template or mandatory-field surface classification.
Screenshot QA and visual-state JSON for list context, action/dropdown or tooltip context, any cancel-safe template surface and no-write end state.
Clear decision whether the next step is customer descriptive write-gate prep, more source review, or parking Master Data writes.
stopConditions: Stop if Business Central is not in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Stop if a template, New, OK, Create, Save or Finish action would create or change data.
Stop if screenshot QA cannot distinguish list, dialog, side pane, search overlay or Role Center background.
Stop if a field or template cannot be inspected without force click, coordinate click or blind typing.
Stop if the route would weaken Foundation setup boundaries or imply O2C/P2P/Inventory readiness.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use only if customer descriptive fields and cancel-safe template/mandatory-field boundaries are proven and posting/VAT/payment dependencies stay untouched.
Use if read-first evidence contradicts the planned template route and requires a local re-decision.
Use if Foundation setup dependencies block even a narrow descriptive customer write gate.
